# Epics and stories

Use an approved brief/spec as source of truth. Group work into outcome-based
epics and small stories with user value, acceptance criteria, dependencies,
security/data considerations, and verification. Respect existing Spring,
PostgreSQL/pgvector, RustFS, and Compose boundaries. Do not create GitHub issues
or edit a roadmap unless explicitly asked.
